verdict.rationale: Slate's docs say the agent can run integration tests itself, and users can run shell commands directly with `!`, so the product does support running checks. Nothing in the evidence covers inspecting diffs or a pre-merge review workflow; permission approval prompts are an adjacent control, not diff review. missing for 10: diff inspection/viewer, pre-merge review workflow, documented check/lint/CI integration, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inspect diffs and run checks to catch problems before merging

citations.quote: Slate is one of the few agents capable of performing integration tests manually.
